tasks.label: phase6-postburst-evidence-summary
args: $adb='C:\Users\Me\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe'; $pkg='com.circuitsyndicate.findingtheway'; $state=& $adb shell run-as $pkg cat shared_prefs/interaction_logger_state.xml; $sid=''; foreach($l in $state){ if($l -match '<string name="session_id">([^<]+)</string>'){ $sid=$matches[1]; break } }; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($sid)){ Write-Output 'SESSION_ID_NOT_FOUND'; exit 0 }; $path=('files/session_evidence/session_' + $sid + '_live.log'); $lines=& $adb shell run-as $pkg tail -n 12000 $path; $startIds=@(); foreach($l in $lines){ if($l -match 'GLASSES_CYCLE\] event=CYCLE_START id=(\d+);mode=BURST'){ $startIds += [int]$matches[1] } }; if($startIds.Count -eq 0){ Write-Output ('SESSION_ID=' + $sid); Write-Output 'NO_BURST_CYCLE_START'; exit 0 }; $lastId=$startIds[$startIds.Count-1]; Write-Output ('SESSION_ID=' + $sid); Write-Output ('LATEST_BURST_ID=' + $lastId); $stageRows=@(); foreach($l in $lines){ if($l -match ('GLASSES_CYCLE\] event=CYCLE_STAGE id=' + $lastId + ';mode=BURST;stage=([A-Z_]+);.*duration_ms=([-0-9]+)')){ $stageRows += [pscustomobject]@{Stage=$matches[1];Duration=[int]$matches[2]} } }; if($stageRows.Count -eq 0){ Write-Output 'NO_STAGE_ROWS_FOR_LATEST_BURST' } else { $present=($stageRows | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Stage -Unique | Sort-Object); Write-Output ('STAGES_PRESENT=' + ($present -join ',')); foreach($req in @('COMMAND','CAPTURE','TRANSFER','INFERENCE')){ Write-Output ('HAS_' + $req + '=' + ($(if($present -contains $req){'YES'}else{'NO'}))) }; Write-Output '---STAGE_DETAILS---'; $stageRows | Sort-Object Stage | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('stage=' + $_.Stage + ';duration_ms=' + $_.Duration) } }; $completeRows=@(); foreach($l in $lines){ if($l -match ('GLASSES_CYCLE\] event=CYCLE_COMPLETED id=' + $lastId + ';mode=BURST;.*total_ms=([-0-9]+)')){ $completeRows += [int]$matches[1] } }; if($completeRows.Count -gt 0){ Write-Output ('CYCLE_TOTAL_MS=' + $completeRows[$completeRows.Count-1]) } else { Write-Output 'CYCLE_TOTAL_MS=UNKNOWN' }; $burstSwapLines = $lines | Select-String 'GLASSES_MODEL_SWAP.*profile=BURST' | Select-Object -Last 12; Write-Output '---BURST_SWAP_LINES---'; if($burstSwapLines){ $burstSwapLines | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_.Line } } else { Write-Output 'NONE' }; $burstUsingL = $lines | Select-String 'GLASSES_MODEL_SWAP.*profile=BURST.*yolov8l-oiv7\.onnx'; Write-Output ('BURST_PROFILE_REFERENCES_YOLOV8L=' + $(if($burstUsingL){'YES'}else{'NO'}));
